name: Gyulaháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a yellow stripe along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Gyulaháza (a white and blue shield with a heart, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name GYULAHÁZA in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gyulaháza arms with helm, crest and mantling
